minimal_kernel: representation and Claim are not silently equated with reality or truth
scope, Context, warrant/provenance and Authority assumptions are explicit where materially relevant
Unknown, uncertainty and unsupported states remain representable without coercion to False
change, revision, supersession, retention and loss are accountable for the declared scope
equivalence, capability, degradation and loss claims are declared against preregistered observables
reference_taxonomy_not_universal_shape: A3 K-to-K-prime transition catalogue and outcome vocabulary
A5 seven identity kinds and eight temporal dimensions

bounded_accountability.rule: Compaction or forgetting outside the declared retention scope may be conformant only when the loss boundary is explicit; silent overwrite inside the retained accountability scope is non-conformant.

threat_model_boundary.mechanism_rule: Architecture requires explicit trust assumptions and failure/uncertainty semantics, not one universal cryptographic mechanism.

hard_refutation_observations: Non-event realization preserves the minimal purpose but cannot expose A3/A6 catalogues: weaken the catalogues, do not reject the realization for that reason.
Bounded compaction preserves declared current semantics and a loss witness but cannot reconstruct superseded detail: weaken universal reconstructability/history.
Profiles match final outputs while materially differing in provenance, uncertainty or Authority: full semantic equivalence is refuted for that scope.
Opaque substrate cannot provide independent physical-erasure evidence: physical erasure remains INDETERMINATE for that scope.
Any post-execution change to mandatory obligations, applicability, equivalence predicates or failure thresholds requires a new experiment identity and cannot rescue the prior outcome.

findings.reconciliation_record: Conformance scope, applicability, observables, equivalence predicates and failure thresholds move to a preregistered scenario-to-obligation oracle controlled outside the implementation. Post-hoc rescoping invalidates the run for the claimed scope.

A3 transition families/outcomes, A6 lifecycle positions and Receipt/Event-shaped accountability are reference taxonomies, not the minimum universal Kernel shape. BPV-1 must independently derive its state/change/history model from problem-level obligations and map to these taxonomies only after execution design is fixed.

Accountability is separated from exact reconstructability. Current accountability, declared retention scope and explicit loss witness are candidate obligations; exact replay, permanent predecessor visibility and unbounded reopening are optional capabilities unless a preregistered scenario requires them.

A5 identity/time inventories remain analytic vocabulary. A scenario declares which identity relations and temporal/order dimensions are materially required; unsupported dimensions must be explicit rather than assumed universally latent.

Portable epistemic obligation is non-conflation of roles/relations, not mandatory first-class fields. Every conflict test must preregister proposition identity, logic/conflict relation, contextual and temporal alignment, assessment Authority and allowed unresolved outcomes; these may not be changed after results are observed.

Logical disposition, physical/cryptographic substrate-condition claims and epistemic forgetting are separate claim classes. Physical/cryptographic erasure requires threat-scoped evidence from an Authority not identical to the unverified self-assertion; absent sufficient evidence the outcome is INDETERMINATE, not stronger erasure.

Hard refutation observations are part of the preregistered oracle and cannot be weakened, reclassified or rescoped after execution. Any such change creates a new experiment identity; the prior outcome remains recorded.

An architecture-level threat-model boundary is added: protected meanings, trust roots/assumptions, adversary capabilities and failure semantics must be declared independently of any profile cryptography. BPV-1 planning must include negative cases for fork, truncation, rollback, forged Authority/provenance and unavailable/colluding witnesses where relevant.

Context/Provenance/Authority evaluation must declare a finite grounding mode: externally attested root, explicit assumed root, bounded recursive closure, declared cycle, or terminal Unknown/gap. Grounding assumptions are part of conformance meaning and cannot be hidden.

Base substrate-independence claims are narrowed to scoped non-composed realizations. Composition/federation is a separate capability class and local conformance does not imply composed conformance; any future composition test must declare overlap, identity, provenance, Authority, concurrency and partial-failure semantics.
